newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN PARLIAMENT CTTEE ORDERS GENDARMERIE RAID.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN PARLIAMENT CTTEE ORDERS GENDARMERIE RAID.

text.p: Officers working under Belgium's parliamentary commission of inquiry into the country's child sex scandal on Monday raided the headquarters of the Gendarmerie in Brussels, legal sources told Reuters.

The raid at the Central Investigation Office in Etterbeek, Brussels, involved around 12 officers, including the head of the police's own supervisory committee. They left the building carrying boxes, a Reuters photographer at the scene said.
Members of the committee were not immediately available to comment.
